gumtree_entries.description: ADDED i1: Tests for {@link JsonIncludeProperties.Value#all()}, which represents the "include all properties" sentinel — the default state when no filtering is configured.
ADDED i2: The canonical "include everything" value: null included-set means no filtering applied.
ADDED i3: {@code from(null)} must return the shared ALL singleton, not a new instance, because null annotation source means "no restriction configured".
ADDED i4: The ALL value reports a null included-set to signal "no filtering" — null is intentionally distinct from an empty set, which would mean "include nothing".
ADDED i5: The ALL value reports a null ordered flag to signal "ordering not specified".
ADDED i6: The ALL value must be equal to itself (reflexive equality).
ADDED i7: The string representation encodes both fields so that log output and diagnostic messages are self-describing.
ADDED i8: The ALL value hashes to 0 because both {@code _included} and {@code _ordered} are null, contributing nothing to the hash.
